caption: The drawing features two elongated rectangular objects positioned diagonally, each with a decorative end loop. The object on the left is rendered in shades of brown, tan, and white, and depicts two horses hitched to a two-wheeled cart or chariot, with detailed wheels and outlines of the animals in motion. The end loop on this object is oval shaped and gray. The object on the right is rendered in yellow, black, and dark brown, and features a detailed scene with three human figures in black: two standing near an architectural structure and one seated figure. There is also a large dog or lion nearby, facing toward the figures. This object's end loop is colored silver-gray and contains three small medallion-like decorations. The drawing is set against a beige background.
title: Belts
